---
title: "easydta: paired test-comparison DTA meta-analysis (CT vs MRI)"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
if (!requireNamespace("easydta", quietly = TRUE)) {
  remotes::install_github("vanioljantunes/easydta")
}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, grid, gridExtra, easydta)
```

```{r load_data}
# Cochrane Handbook Appendix 12 schuetz dataset: CT vs MRI for coronary
# artery disease.  Bundled wide frame, one row per study, with `.e` (CT)
# and `.c` (MRI) suffixed columns -- every study evaluated BOTH tests
# (paired / direct design).
data(schuetz)
d <- schuetz
head(d)
```

```{r analyse}
# One call for the paired comparison: wide `.e`/`.c` frame in, full
# pipeline out (reshape + LR fit + comparison + per-arm single fits).
# `.e` = CT (index), `.c` = MRI (comparator).
res <- dta_pairwise(d,
                    studlab      = "studlab",
                    intervention = "CT",
                    control      = "MRI")
print(res)
```

```{r save_forest_CT}
png("forest_CT.png", width = 1400, height = 700, res = 150)
dta_forest(res, arm = "CT")
dev.off()
```

```{r save_forest_MRI}
png("forest_MRI.png", width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 150)
dta_forest(res, arm = "MRI")
dev.off()
```

```{r save_funnel}
# Cochrane Handbook ch. 10.6.4 / Deeks, Macaskill & Irwig (2005):
# funnel plot of ln(DOR) against 1/sqrt(ESS) plus the weighted-regression
# Deeks test for funnel asymmetry (proxy for publication bias).  Per arm.
png("funnel_CT.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(
  dta_funnel(res, arm = "CT",
             test = "CT",
             outcome    = "coronary artery disease",
             population = "adults with suspected CAD")
)
dev.off()

png("funnel_MRI.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(
  dta_funnel(res, arm = "MRI",
             test = "MRI",
             outcome    = "coronary artery disease",
             population = "adults with suspected CAD")
)
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc_pairwise}
# Per-arm SROC (separate panels, saved side by side).  `.e` is the index
# arm (CT) and `.c` is the comparator arm (MRI).  Beneath the panels a
# Cochrane-style table reports per-arm Sens/Spec/AUC with 95% CIs, the
# absolute differences (.e - .c), and p-values:
#   * Sens/Spec p-values come from the LR tests (Cochrane Appendix 12,
#     Table A12.1 rows 2-3 in `res$compare$lr_tests`).
#   * AUC inference uses dmetatools::AUC_comparison() (Noma & Matsushima
#     2020) -- joint parametric bootstrap that returns each arm's AUC,
#     dAUC, their CIs, and the p-value for dAUC = 0.  Set
#     `auc_ic = FALSE` to skip the bootstrap (faster preview; AUC row is
#     omitted and the in-panel AUC summary loses its CI).
png("sroc_pairwise.png", width = 1800, height = 1000, res = 150)
g <- dta_sroc_pair(res,
                   arm.e  = "CT",  test.e = "CT",
                   arm.c  = "MRI", test.c = "MRI",
                   outcome    = "coronary artery disease",
                   population = "adults with suspected CAD",
                   auc_ic     = TRUE,
                   B          = 2000)
grid::grid.draw(g)
dev.off()
```
